title: Simple Bank System
goal: Process bank transfers, deposits, and withdrawals with valid-account and sufficient-funds checks.
strategy: Accounts are one-based. Validate every requirement before changing balances so failed operations are atomic; a transfer requires both accounts and enough funds in its source.

edgeCases: An invalid destination must not debit the source
Zero money still requires a valid account
Exact balance may be withdrawn completely
